The whole idea, in five lines

五句话讲清楚

A machine has already sorted every file in a submission into keep and discard. This app is where a person checks that sorting, and says where the machine was wrong.

机器已把一份提交里的每个文件分成「保留」和「剔除」。 这个应用供人对这一分类作出裁定，也让机器从中得知错在何处。

  • The machine goes first. Every file already has an answer on it before you arrive.
  • You only mark what is wrong. Most rows you never touch, and that is the intended way to work.
  • Leaving a row alone is not agreement until you Confirm. One Confirm per submission turns "nobody read this" into "a person approved it".
  • A submission nobody confirmed counts for nothing — however many of its rows were marked.
  • The sentence you type is what gets a rule changed. A percentage only says the machine was wrong; your sentence says where.
  • 机器先做。你打开之前，每个文件都已有了答案。
  • 你只处理例外。只修改机器判错的那几行，其余保持原样 —— 这正是预期的使用方式。
  • 不改动某一行，并不代表同意 —— 除非你按了确认。每份提交按一次 Confirm（确认），才会从「无人审阅」变为「已获核准」。
  • 未经确认的提交一律无效 —— 无论标记了多少行。
  • 你写的理由才是真正的产出。百分比只说明机器出错了； 你写的那句话，才能说明错在哪里。

RWhat is your role你的角色与职责

Five people and one machine touch a submission. Find yourself here first — most questions further down are really questions about which of these you are.

一份提交要经过五种角色的人和一台机器。请先在这里找到自己 —— 后文的大部分问题，实质上都是「你属于哪一个角色」的问题。

Reviewer

审阅人（reviewer）

Signs in as reviewer. Sees only what was assigned to them.

以 reviewer 角色登录。只能看到分派给自己的内容。

You own
Going through the submissions given to you, one at a time.
You decide
Whether each file belongs in the pack — but only where the machine got it wrong. Everything else stands as it is.
You must not
Decide who reviews what, approve anything, or open a submission nobody gave you. The server refuses all three.
You are finished when
You press Confirm. That is your review.
你负责
把分派给你的提交，一份一份看完。
你决定
每个文件该不该进最终材料包 —— 但只在机器判错的地方动手，其余保持原样。
你不可以
决定谁审哪一份、做审批、或打开没有分给你的提交。 这三件事服务端都会直接拒绝。
做完的标志
你按下 Confirm。那就是你的审阅。

Admin

管理员（admin）

Signs in as admin. Sees and may write everything.

以 admin 角色登录。所有内容都能看、都能写。

You own
Accounts, who is given what, the address the app answers on, and getting the answers safely off the workstation.
You may
Review any submission and approve any submission. You also get the aggregate figures and the back-office screens.
You must not
Read a rate off the screen and call it accuracy. See what the numbers mean.
Your standing job
Pack the results at the end of any day people reviewed — nothing does it for you.
你负责
账号、谁做哪一份、应用对外的地址，以及把答案安全地从工作站带出来。
你可以
审阅任何一份提交，也可以审批任何一份。 汇总数字和后台界面也都归你看。
你不可以
把屏幕上的某个比率直接当成「准确率」对外说。见 这些数字能说明什么。
你的日常职责
只要当天有人审过，收工时就把结果打包带走 —— 没有任何东西会自动替你做。

Developer

开发人员（developer）

Signs in as developer. Sees everything an admin sees.

以 developer 角色登录。admin 看到的都能看到。

You own
Looking. Diagnosing. Changing the code, elsewhere.
You may
Read every submission and every aggregate figure.
You cannot
Write anything — not a ruling, not a confirmation, not an account. Every write is refused at the server, by role.
Why the role exists
So somebody can be shown the real screens without being able to move a number on them.
你负责
查看、排查问题；改代码是在别处改。
你可以
查看每一份提交和所有汇总数字。
你做不到
写入任何东西 —— 裁定、确认、账号都不行。 所有写操作都在服务端按角色拒绝。
为什么要有这个角色
这样就可以让人看到真实界面， 而不用担心他改动上面任何一个数字。

The Submission Agent

Submission Agent（机器）

Not a person, and not a role. It has already run before anybody signs in.

不是人，也不是一种角色。在任何人登录之前，它已经跑完了。

It owns
A first answer on every file, the rule it cites for that answer, and a verdict on how much of its own work it trusts — the gate.
It decides
Nothing finally. Its answer is the default on the row, and a person may take it away. Even the gate only sets the order you work in.
It must not
Be treated as the reference a person is scored against. It is one opinion of two.
What it needs from you
The sentence you type when you overrule it. That is the only thing that changes a rule.
它负责
给每个文件一个初判、写明依据的是哪条规则， 并对自己这次分类有多可信给出判断 —— 即关卡（gate）。
它决定
什么都不最终决定。它的答案只是那一行的默认值，人可以拿掉； 连关卡也只是决定你先做哪一份。
不可以
把它当成用来给人打分的标准答案。它只是两种意见中的一种。
它需要你给的
你推翻它时写下的那句话。只有这个能让规则真正被改掉。

Reviewing and approving are jobs, not roles

「审阅」和「审批」是任务，不是角色

Your role is one of the three above and never changes. What changes per submission is the job the assignment list gives you on it: you were asked to review it, or to approve it, or neither. An admin holds one role and may do both jobs; a reviewer holds one role and does one job.

你的角色就是上面三种之一，不会变。 每份提交上会变的是分派清单给你的任务： 请你审阅它、请你审批它，或者两者都不是。 admin 只有一种角色，但两种任务都能做；reviewer 只有一种角色，也只做一种任务。

JobWhat finishing it means
Review You went through the submission and confirmed. That alone makes it reviewed. Two reviewers means two people were asked — neither signs the other off, and neither waits on the other.
Approve You read what the reviewers said and confirmed. You also hold the final verdict on any document they answered differently. Optional: most submissions have no approver.
任务做完意味着什么
审阅 你把这份提交过了一遍并按了确认，它就算已审阅了。 两位审阅人只表示请了两个人来读 —— 谁也不为谁签字，谁也不用等谁。
审批 你读了审阅人给出的意见并按了确认。 凡是他们看法不同的文件，最终以你的裁定为准。 这是可选的：大多数提交没有审批人。
One role each, and one rule about jobs 每人一种角色，任务只有一条规则

Each person has exactly one role. Jobs are per submission: the same admin can review one and approve another. The one thing refused is doing both on the same submission — approving your own review is the same opinion written twice.

每个人只有一种角色。任务是按提交分的： 同一位 admin 可以审这一份、批另一份。 唯一被禁止的是在同一份提交上两件事都做 —— 给自己的审阅做审批，等于把同一个意见写了两遍。

AWhich setup is yours — read this first你属于哪一种部署 —— 先看这个

There are three ways to run this. Pick yours and the rest of the page follows.

有三种用法都称为「flywheel」。选择属于你的那一种，页面会随之切换。

What the three actually are

这三种到底是什么

SetupWhat runsSign-in Who can use it
A — this machine python validate\serve.py on one machine No — it is just you at that keyboard Whoever is sitting at that machine
B — hosted The same program, plus a validate\server_config.json Yes, everybody Anyone the config gives an account
C — the sheet Nothing. One HTML file on a shared folder No Anyone who can open the folder
部署运行的是什么需要登录吗 谁能使用
A — 本机 在一台机器上运行 python validate\serve.py 不需要 —— 因为不存在「谁」的概念 坐在那台机器前的人
B — 服务端 同一个程序，外加一个 validate\server_config.json 需要，所有人都需要 配置文件里有账号的人
C — 离线表单 不运行任何程序。共享文件夹上的一个 HTML 文件 不需要 能打开那个文件夹的任何人
The one rule that decides it 决定一切的那一条规则

The presence of the file validate\server_config.json is what turns sign-in on. Create it and everybody signs in; delete it and the app goes back to this-machine only, with no sign-in and no log. There is no flag, no setting and no menu. On every machine except the one server, that file is absent today — which means no sign-in.

是否需要登录，取决于 validate\server_config.json 该文件是否存在。 存在则全员登录；不存在即为本机模式：不登录、不记日志。 没有其他开关、设置项或菜单 —— 除服务器外，每台机器目前都没有这个文件。

BThe two words that cause the most confusion最容易混淆的两个词

WordWhat it is What it is not
An account A name and a password. It lets you in. It does not give you any work. An account with no assignment signs in and sees an empty screen — that means nobody has given you a submission yet, and that is normal.
An assignment A line in data\_overview\assignments.csv saying who reviews a submission, and who approves it if anybody does. It gives you work. It is not a login. A name on the list with no account cannot sign in at all.
词它是什么 它不是什么
账号 由名字和密码组成，供你登录使用。 它不会给你任何工作。只有账号、没有分派的人登录后会看到空白页面 —— 这正是「尚未分配工作」的正常状态。
分派 data\_overview\assignments.csv 里的一行， 写明谁审、谁签核。它给你工作。 它不是登录凭证。名字在清单上但没有账号的人，无法登录。

You need both. They are edited in two different places, and that is on purpose: the accounts file holds passwords and never leaves the server; the assignment list is committed, reviewable and travels with the code.

两者缺一不可，且有意分开维护： 账号文件含有密码，绝不离开服务器；分派清单则入库、可复核，随代码一同流转。

Not this one 请勿混淆

setup.json, inside each treaty folder, is a third thing and has nothing to do with people. It says whether that treaty is in scope for the build. Nobody reviewing needs to open it.

各合约文件夹中的 setup.json 是第三种东西， 与人员无关：它仅说明该合约是否纳入本次构建。审阅人员无需理会。

1Open it打开

Someone sends you an address. Everything happens in the browser; there is nothing to install.

有人会发给你一个网址。一切都在浏览器中进行，无需安装任何软件。

关于截图

界面截图是英文的，因为应用本身就是英文界面。 下文提到按钮和栏目时，会附上屏幕上的英文原词。

No sign-in page? 没看到登录页？

Then you are on Setup A, and there is nothing to sign in to. Skip straight to the review screen. You will not see My work — that screen only exists when there are people to tell apart.

说明你使用的是部署 A，本就无需登录，可直接进入审阅界面。 同样也没有 My work（我的工作） —— 该界面仅在需要区分人员时才存在。

The session ends by itself after a while of doing nothing. You lose nothing: every answer is saved the moment you press it, not when you leave.

闲置一段时间后会自动登出，但不会丢失任何内容： 每个答案在按下的一刻即已保存，而非离开时才保存。

2Find your work找到你的工作

You land here. It shows only what has been given to you — not because the screen is hiding the rest, but because the server refuses it.

登录后首先进入此页。这里只显示分派给你的内容 —— 并非界面隐藏了其余，而是服务端本就不提供。

The colour beside every submission

每份提交旁边的那个颜色

The gate is a verdict the machine passes on its own work: it reads the result it produced for one submission and says how much of it can be trusted. Nobody's opinion goes into it, and it never changes what a file is — it only says how carefully somebody should look.

关卡（gate）是机器对自己这次分类下的判断： 它读一遍自己给这份提交做出的结果，说明其中有多少可以信任。 其中不含任何人的意见，也不会改变任何文件的判定 —— 它只说明人应该看得多仔细。

ColourWhat it is telling you
Not trusted (red)The sorting itself did not hold up. Go through the whole submission — this is where your time is worth most, and it is why the queue puts these first.
Check first (amber)Nearly there. The machine names the short list it is unsure about; clear those and it can go.
Ships as is (green)Every check held. The pack could go downstream without anyone reading it.
颜色它在告诉你什么
Not trusted 不可信（红） 分类本身没有通过检查。整份都要过一遍 —— 你的时间花在这里最值，队列也因此把它们排在最前。
Check first 先查一下（黄） 差一点点。机器会列出它拿不准的少数文件；把那几个处理掉即可放行。
Ships as is 可原样放行（绿） 全部检查通过。这份材料包可以不经人工阅读直接交付下游。

Your review moves it. Two of the things that turn a submission red — too much the machine could not place, too many files left pending — are exactly what a reviewer resolves. Once you have been through it, run the gate again from the submission's own header and the colour is recomputed with your answers in it.

你的审阅会改变这个颜色。 使一份提交变红的原因里，有两条正是审阅人能解决的 —— 机器无法归类的文件太多、悬而未决的文件太多。 你审完之后，在该提交的标题栏按「run the gate again（重新跑一次关卡）」， 颜色就会带着你的答案重新算过。

Empty screen? 界面一片空白？

You have an account but no assignment. That is not a fault — nobody has given you a submission yet. Ask the project team to add you to the assignment list.

说明你有账号但没有分派。这不是故障 —— 只是尚未有人把工作分给你， 请联系项目组将你加入分派清单。

3The review screen审阅界面

This is where the work happens. The machine has already answered every row; you are looking for the ones it got wrong.

审阅工作就在这个界面完成。机器已经给每一行填好了答案； 你要找的，是它填错的那几行。

Read this once and the screen makes sense 看懂这一段，就理解了整个界面

The four piles are not four kinds of work. They are the machine's four answers, put side by side so you can spend your attention where being wrong is expensive — the dropped pile — and move fast through the pile where it is not.

这四堆并非四种工作，而是机器的四种答案并排展示： 把注意力放在「出错代价大」的被剔除堆，在代价较小的堆上快速处理。

4The buttons on a row每一行上的按钮

Three fixed positions on every row, always in the same order, always naming what happens to the file.

每行三个按钮，位置和顺序固定， 按钮名称始终表示该文件的去向。

ButtonWhat it means
DropThis file does not belong in the pack. Whether the machine already thought so or not.
KeepThis file does belong in the pack.
FlagSomebody else should look. Not an answer — a hand raised. It is counted separately and never as a ruling.
按钮含义
Drop（剔除）该文件不应进入材料包。 无论机器原本是否也如此判定。
Keep（保留）该文件应进入材料包。
Flag（标记）应请他人再看一眼。这不是一个答案 —— 只是举手示意。它单独计数，永远不算作裁定。

The one already highlighted is the machine's answer. Pressing it again takes your answer back and leaves the row as the machine had it.

高亮显示的是机器的答案。再次按下即撤回你的意见， 恢复机器原判。

A flag belongs to whoever raised it 标记属于举手的那个人

Only the person who flagged a row can take the flag off. On somebody else's flag the row says who put it there and offers no button — a control that cannot work is worse than no control, because pressing it looks like the app is broken.

只有当初做标记的人才能取消该标记。 别人做的标记，行内会写明是谁做的，并且不提供按钮 —— 按不动的按钮比没有按钮更糟，因为按下去会让人以为程序坏了。

Why they never change name 为什么按钮名称从不变化

There used to be one button whose label changed from row to row, so a reviewer had to read before pressing. Fixed positions mean the hand learns it once. If you have used the review sheet, note that it still has the older single button — same act, different control.

早先只有一个按钮，其文字随不同行变化，审阅人每次按下前都需先读一遍。 位置固定后，手只需记住一次。 离线表单仍为旧的单按钮式 —— 作用相同，控件不同。

5When you have to give a reason什么时候必须写理由

Contradicting the machine takes one click and, sometimes, one sentence.

推翻机器的判定，只需一次点击 —— 有时还需一句话。

Type it, then press — in that order 先输入内容，再按按钮 —— 顺序不能颠倒

The comment box is read at the moment you press a button. Type your sentence first, then press Drop, Keep or Flag. Clicking away to another row before pressing loses what you typed.

备注在按下按钮的那一刻才会被读取。 请先输入内容，再按 Drop、Keep 或 Flag。 若未按就切换到其他行，已输入的内容会丢失。

6The keyboard键盘操作

KeyDoes
↓ ↑Next file, previous file
dDrop it
kKeep it
fFlag it for somebody to look at
cClear — take your answer back
/Jump to the search box
EscLeave the search box
按键作用
↓ ↑下一个 / 上一个文件
d剔除（Drop）
k保留（Keep）
f标记，请人来看（Flag）
c撤回你的答案（Clear）
/跳到搜索框
Esc离开搜索框

The keys are printed under the search box on the screen itself, so there is nothing to memorise.

这些按键在界面上就印在搜索框下方，无需记忆。

7Confirm — the step that makes it count确认 —— 让工作真正生效的那一步

The one thing to get right 唯一不能出错的一件事

A submission you did not confirm counts for nothing, however many rows you marked. Marking rows records disagreements. Confirming is what says a person went through this submission. Without it the record still says nobody has read it.

未经确认的提交一律无效，无论标记了多少行。 标记记录的是分歧；确认才表示有人完整审阅了这份提交。 不按确认，记录上即为「无人审阅」。

The green button at the top right says how many files you are approving and under whose name. Press it when you have been through the submission — not when you have touched every row. Touching most rows is not the intended way to work.

右上角的绿色按钮会写明你核准的文件数和名义。 审阅完这份提交即可按下 —— 无需每行都处理。 处理大部分行，本就不是这个工具的设计用法。

What you are agreeing to

你确认的到底是什么

Exactly the three counts above the button: this many decided by hand, this many flagged, this many left as proposed — they add up to the whole submission. You are answerable for all of them; you simply did not have to touch most.

即按钮上方的三个数字：多少人工判定、多少标记、 多少保持原判 —— 三者之和即整份提交。 这些均由你负责，只是大部分无需亲自处理。

Changing your mind afterwards

事后改变主意

Reopen the submission and press again. Nothing is ever overwritten: the record is added to, and the newest answer from you is the one that counts. Across two people there is no "newest" — see the role cards above.

重新打开这份提交，再按一次即可。不会覆盖： 记录只会追加，以你自己最新的答案为准。 但两人之间不存在「最新」—— 见前文的角色说明。

If the documents change under you 如果文件在你确认之后发生变化

If the submission is triaged again after you confirmed, your approval is marked stale rather than quietly standing. It was an approval of a set of documents, and that set moved.

确认后若这份提交被重新分类， 你的核准将标记为已过期（stale），而不会继续默默生效 —— 因为你当初核准的那组文件已经发生变化。

8MVP20 — a submission somebody went through firstMVP20 —— 事先已有人过过一遍的提交

Twenty submissions were gone through by an analyst before the machine's answer was visible. They carry the tag MVP20 in the app, they look different, and the difference matters.

有二十份提交，在机器的答案可见之前， 已由分析人员完整过了一遍。它们在应用中标记为 MVP20， 界面显示方式不同，而这个区别很重要。

These twenty are the set the machine's rules were written against, and they count as reviewed — the work was done, it was simply done somewhere other than this app, which is why their cards stay grey. Here two opinions already exist — the machine's and the analyst's — and the app never resolves the disagreement for you. The three groups mean different work:

这二十份正是机器规则据以制定的那一批，它们算已审阅 —— 工作确实做过了，只是做在本应用之外，所以卡片仍是灰色。 此处已存在两种意见 —— 机器的和分析人员的 —— 应用不会替你裁决分歧。三个分组对应的工作性质不同：

GroupWhat it means
Missed by triageThe dangerous one. The machine would have discarded a document the analyst kept.
Kept by triage onlyThe machine kept something the analyst dropped. A precision problem, not a dangerous one.
Left undecidedThe machine made no claim either way. Parked, not lost.
分组含义
机器漏掉的（Missed by triage） 危险的一类：分析人员保留了，机器却会丢弃。
只有机器保留的（Kept by triage only） 分析人员剔除了，机器却保留。属于「不够精准」，并非危险。
机器未裁定的（Left undecided） 机器未作表态。属于搁置，并非丢失。
The analyst is not the answer key 分析人员的选择不是标准答案

The person's pick is one of two opinions, not the truth the machine is scored against. Every row offers you the same two buttons in the same order, and neither is labelled "confirm" or named after whoever said it. That is deliberate: naming a source would tell you whose side to take.

人工选择只是两种意见之一， 并非给机器打分的真值。每行提供同样的两个按钮、同样的顺序， 既不标「确认」，也不注明出自谁手。这是有意为之： 标注来源，就等于在天平上施加了偏向。

9Glossary — the words on the screen词汇表 —— 界面上那些词

Built into the app. It mirrors the machine's actual rule ladder, so it says what the machine really did rather than what somebody remembers it doing.

词汇表内置于应用中，对应机器真实的规则序列 —— 它描述的是机器的实际行为，而非某人的记忆。

Four sections are worth knowing about before you need them: what the machine can say about a file (six answers, only one of which puts a document in the pack), whether it could read it, what kind of document it thinks it is, and the rule ladder in the order the rules are tried.

有四节值得先看一眼，不必等到需要时才找： 机器对一个文件能说什么（六种答案，只有一种会把文件放进材料包）、 它能不能读出内容、它认为这是哪一类文档， 以及规则序列及其尝试顺序。

The one that goes wrong most often 最常出错的那一条

The rule that grants a file core on its type works by counting keyword matches across the folder path, the filename and whatever text the machine could read — most matches wins. So it goes wrong on words far more often than on logic: a covering letter that mentions "statement of values" six times can be typed as one. The glossary lists a sample of the words each kind is looked for by, which is what makes an overrule worth writing down.

按文档类型判定核心的那条规则， 做法是在文件夹路径、文件名和机器能读到的正文里数关键词命中次数， 命中最多的类型胜出。因此它在用词上出错，远多于在逻辑上出错： 一封六次提到 “statement of values” 的说明函， 可能就被判成了一份价值明细表。 词汇表列出了每一类所查关键词的样例 —— 正因如此，推翻它的时候写下理由才有价值。

1Start the server启动服务

One command. What it does depends entirely on whether a configuration file exists.

一条命令。其行为完全取决于配置文件是否存在。

# Setup A - this machine only, no sign-in
python validate\serve.py

# ...and let filenames open the actual document
python validate\serve.py --files-root "C:\raw\<round>"

# Does the corpus hold together? Opens no port, writes nothing
python validate\serve.py --check

# An invented corpus, for a machine with no documents at all
python validate\serve.py --mock
# 部署 A - 仅本机，不登录
python validate\serve.py

# ...并让文件名可以点开实际文档
python validate\serve.py --files-root "C:\raw\<round>"

# 数据自身是否自洽？不开端口，不写入任何内容
python validate\serve.py --check

# 一套虚构数据，供完全没有文档的机器使用
python validate\serve.py --mock
Without --files-root the filenames are plain text 不加 --files-root，文件名就只是文字

They are not links, and clicking does nothing. The app is served over http, where a file:// link fails silently — so it does not offer one. If your reviewers need to open documents, this flag is not optional.

此时文件名不是链接，点击无效：http 环境下 file:// 链接会静默失效，因此应用干脆不提供。 若审阅人需要打开文档，该参数必不可少。

2Turn on sign-in (Setup B)开启登录（部署 B）

Five steps, in this order. Steps 1–3 run on the coding PC; the result travels to the server in the code zip.

共五步，按顺序执行。第 1–3 步在开发机上完成， 结果随代码压缩包带到服务器。

  1. Make the accounts. Each command asks for a password twice and writes nothing else. 
    python validate\serve.py --add-account "First Admin"  --role admin
python validate\serve.py --add-account "Second Admin" --role admin
python validate\serve.py --add-account "A. Reviewer"  --role reviewer
    The first one creates validate\server_config.json — which is the act that turns sign-in on.
  2. Say where it answers. Open that file and set bind to the server's address. Leave it as loopback and only that machine can reach it.
  3. Assign the work — see the next section. An account without an assignment signs in to an empty screen.
  4. Ship it. python bundle.py code carries the accounts file out to the workstation. It prints a line telling you it is doing so, because carrying accounts turns sign-in on over there.
  5. Start it on the server and give people the address.
  1. 创建账号。每条命令会要求输入两次密码，不写入其他内容。 
    python validate\serve.py --add-account "First Admin"  --role admin
python validate\serve.py --add-account "Second Admin" --role admin
python validate\serve.py --add-account "A. Reviewer"  --role reviewer
    第一条会创建 validate\server_config.json —— 正是这个动作开启了登录。
  2. 指定对外地址。打开该文件，将 bind 设为服务器地址。 若保持默认本机地址，则仅本机可以访问。
  3. 分派工作 —— 见下一节。有账号但无分派的人，登录后将看到空界面。
  4. 发布。python bundle.py code 会将账号文件带到工作站， 并打印一行提示 —— 因为将账号带过去即等于在那边开启了登录。
  5. 在服务器上启动，然后把地址发给大家。
RoleSeesCan write
reviewerOnly the submissions assigned to them Rulings and confirmations on those
adminEverything, plus Progress, Reviewer activity, Rules feedback, Assign work and Accounts Everything: reviews any, approves any
developerThe same screens as admin Nothing at all — refused at the server
角色能看到能写入
reviewer（审阅人）只有分派给他的提交 这些提交上的裁定和确认
admin（管理员）全部，另加 Progress（进度）、 Reviewer activity（审阅人活动）、Rules feedback（规则反馈）、 Assign work（分派工作）和 Accounts（账号） 全部：任何一份都能审、都能批
developer（开发）界面和 admin 一样 不允许任何写入 —— 服务端直接拒绝
Refused, not hidden 是拒绝，不是隐藏

A reviewer asking for another reviewer's submission, its documents, or a write against it is refused by the server — not merely left off their screen. And the name recorded against every answer is taken from the sign-in, never from what the page sent.

审阅人请求他人的提交、文档，或对其写入， 均被服务端拒绝 —— 而非仅在界面上不显示。 每个答案记录的名字取自登录身份，绝不取自页面提交的内容。

Trying it without committing to it

先试用，不做实际改动

Point the app at a throwaway config and an invented corpus. Nothing is written into the repository and no real document is involved:

将应用指向一个临时配置和一套虚构数据： 不写入代码库，也不涉及真实文档。

python validate\serve.py --mock --config C:\tmp\try.json --add-account "Ann" --role reviewer
python validate\serve.py --mock --config C:\tmp\try.json

Delete C:\tmp\try.json and it never happened.

删除 C:\tmp\try.json，即可视为从未发生。

3Assign the work分派工作

One screen, three columns, and it does two jobs at once — who reviews a submission, and whose confirmation signs it off.

一个界面、三列，一次确定两件事 —— 谁审阅这份提交，谁的确认将其签掉。

The shapes that are allowed

允许的几种组合

ShapeWhat it means Finished when
One reviewerOne person reads it. The common case. They confirm
Two reviewers Two people were asked, and read it independently. Neither signs the other off, and a document they answer differently stays contested. Either confirms
Reviewer(s) + approver The approver reads what they said and holds the final verdict on anything they disagreed about. The approver confirms
Nobody namedNot a shape — every submission needs a reviewer. The screen says how many are still like this. Never
组合含义 何时算完成
一位审阅人一个人读它。最常见的情况。 他确认后
两位审阅人 请了两个人各自独立读它。谁也不为谁签字； 两人答案不同的文件保持「有分歧」状态。 任一人确认后
审阅人 + 审批人 审批人读完他们的意见，并对有分歧的文件拥有最终裁定权。 审批人确认后
均未填写这不算一种组合 —— 每份提交都必须有审阅人。 界面会显示还有多少份是这种状态。 永远不会
Refused, and why 会被拒绝的写法，以及原因

Nobody may approve their own review — over your own reading that is not a verdict, it is the same opinion written twice. Two rows of one submission naming different approvers is refused as well. That is the whole list; it used to be four times as long, and the rest went with the adjudicator on 2026-09-04.

不允许给自己的审阅做审批 —— 对自己读过的东西再裁定一次，那不是裁定，只是把同一个意见写了两遍。 同一份提交的两行写了不同的审批人，也会被拒绝。 规则就这两条；原先有四倍之多，其余的已随「仲裁人」于 2026-09-04 一并取消。

Behind the screen it is one committed file, data\_overview\assignments.csv, three columns wide. You can edit it by hand instead; the app reads it fresh on every request.

界面背后是入库的文件 data\_overview\assignments.csv，共三列。 可直接手工编辑；应用每次请求都会重新读取。

tno,reviewer,approver
99901-2026,A. Reviewer,
99904-2026,A. Reviewer,The project team
99906-2026,A. Reviewer,
99906-2026,Second Reviewer,

Three shapes: one reviewer, one reviewer with an approver over them, and two reviewers with nobody over them. The approver column is repeated on every row of its submission, and may be blank.

三种形态：一位审阅人；一位审阅人加一位审批人； 两位审阅人、上面没有人。审批人这一列会在该提交的每一行重复写，也可以留空。

4All treaties — the corpus dashboardAll treaties —— 总览看板

The project team's landing screen. Where the book stands, how much was filtered, and how the machine is doing.

项目组的首页：整体进展、筛除量与机器表现。

5Progress — who has whatProgress（进度）—— 每份提交在谁手上

One board, grouped by what needs doing. The exceptions are at the top and the finished work is at the bottom, so the first thing you read is the thing to act on.

一块看板，按「需要做什么」分组： 例外情况在最上面，已完成的在最下面 —— 你最先读到的，就是需要处理的那一件。

Two people on one submission appear as two names in who has it. Reviewed is the status of the submission, not of a person: one assigned reviewer confirming is enough, unless an approver was named, in which case it waits for them.

一份提交分派给两个人时，who has it（在谁手上） 一栏会列出两个名字。Reviewed（已审阅）说的是这份提交的状态， 而不是某个人的状态：只要有一位被分派的审阅人确认即可； 若指定了审批人，则要等审批人确认。

6Accounts账号

Where you make an account matters 在哪台机器上创建账号，结果不同

Accounts you add on the server are replaced by the next code zip, because the zip carries the coding PC's copy of the file. Either add people on the coding PC and ship, or point the server at a config outside the code folder with --config. Disabling someone takes effect on their very next request, not at their next sign-in.

在服务器上创建的账号会被下一个代码包覆盖 —— 包中携带的是开发机上的那份。 要么在开发机上创建后再发布，要么用 --config 指向代码目录之外的配置文件。 停用即时生效，无需等待对方重新登录。

7Reviewers, and what the machine keeps getting wrong人员，以及机器反复出错的地方

How to read it

怎么读这个界面

Each reading of the corpus is shown twice, once per direction, and the dangerous one comes first:

每一种「读法」都分成两个方向各列一次， 危险的那个方向排在前面：

BlockWhat a row in it costs
Rules that threw a file away somebody wanted The expensive direction. Nothing downstream catches a document triage discarded — if the rule is wrong, the document is simply gone.
Rules that kept a file nobody wanted A precision defect. The pack is fatter than it should be, and somebody downstream reads a page they did not need to.
区块其中一行意味着什么代价
Rules that threw a file away somebody wanted （把别人要的文件扔掉的规则） 代价高的那个方向。分类阶段丢掉的文件，下游没有任何环节能发现 —— 规则若判错，文件就真的没了。
Rules that kept a file nobody wanted （留下了没人要的文件的规则） 精度问题：材料包比应有的更厚，下游有人要多读一份用不上的东西。

A block with nothing in it is still drawn, saying so in words. An absent block and a check that never ran look the same on a screen.

即使某个区块一条都没有，也照样画出来并用文字说明。 在屏幕上，「空的区块」和「根本没做这项检查」看起来是一样的。

ColumnWhat it counts
AnsweredFiles this rule touched that somebody has since ruled on or approved by confirming.
The person agreedOf those, how many they left as the rule had them.
Wanted back / not keptOf those, how many they overturned. This is the number the rule is judged on.
Still openFiles that rule touched which nobody has answered yet. Beside the figures, never inside them — an unfinished book must not make a rule look worse than it is. More open than answered and the row is marked provisional: early, not wrong.
列它数的是什么
Answered（已作答） 这条规则处理过、且已有人裁定或按确认核准的文件数。
The person agreed（人同意） 其中有多少维持了规则的判定。
Wanted back（要回来） / not kept（没留） 其中有多少被人推翻。评价一条规则，看的就是这个数。
Still open（还没答） 这条规则处理过、但还没人作答的文件数。它列在各项数字旁边， 绝不计入其中 —— 书没读完，不该让规则显得比实际更差。 未答多于已答时，该行标为 provisional（暂定）：是早，不是错。
The two readings are never added together 两种读法绝不相加

Answered in this app is somebody who could see the machine's call before they answered. Answered in MVP20 is somebody who could not. They are different evidence about the same rule, so they get their own tables and no combined figure is published anywhere.

Answered in this app（在本应用中作答） 指作答者当时能看到机器的判断； Answered in MVP20（在 MVP20 中作答）指看不到。 两者是关于同一条规则的不同证据，因此各有各的表， 任何地方都不会给出一个合并后的数字。

8What the numbers mean — and what they do not这些数字能说明什么、不能说明什么

FigureHow to read it
Checked here agreement Agreement, not correctness. The reviewer saw the machine's answer before ruling, so it drifts high. The blind sample that would measure this properly is not built.
Missed by the machine A lower bound, never a measured recall. The analyst's selection was made from files triage had already surfaced, so a document it never surfaced cannot appear.
How much was filtered How much work the machine took off the pile. Not an accuracy figure, which is why it sits apart from the grids.
The two grids Two populations, never added together. One is people who saw the machine's answer; the other is people who did not.
Untouched but confirmed Reported separately from rows a person actually stopped on. The blended rate is withheld rather than published with a footnote.
Progress Against the treaties triaged, counted off the disk. Not the size of the book, and the total moves as treaties are triaged.
What the gate says A breakdown, not a journey. It grades the machine's sorting before anybody reads it, so no amount of reviewing moves a bar — re-running the gate on a submission somebody has settled is what changes a colour.
数字如实的解读
Checked here 的一致率 这是一致率，不是正确率。审阅人先看到机器答案再裁定， 因此偏高。能够准确测量的盲样机制尚未建立。
机器漏掉的 这是下限，不是实测的召回率。 分析人员从机器已呈现的文件中挑选， 机器从未呈现的文件不可能计入。
筛掉了多少 反映机器筛除的工作量。不是准确率 —— 因此与那两张表分开呈现。
那两张表 两个不同的样本群，永不相加： 一群看过机器答案，另一群没有。
未改动但被确认的 与「人真正处理过的行」分开报告。 混合比率宁可不发布，也不加脚注充数。
进度 分母是从磁盘统计的已分类合约数，并非业务盘子； 每多分类一个，总数即变化。
What the gate says（关卡的判断） 这是构成分布，不是进度。它评的是人尚未阅读之前机器自己的分类质量， 所以再怎么审阅也不会让某根条变长 —— 只有对已处理完的提交重新跑一次关卡，颜色才会变。

9Where the answers go, and how to check them答案存到哪里，以及怎么检查

data\<TNO>\validations\validations-<reviewer>.csv   one file per person

Append-only: nothing is ever rewritten. Each person has their own file, and "newest wins" is a rule about one person — across two people there is no newest, and a disagreement stays a disagreement until an approver settles it, on the submissions that have one.

只追加，不改写。每人一个文件； 「以最新为准」仅适用于同一个人 —— 两人之间不存在「最新」，分歧保持原样， 直到审批人做出裁定（在有审批人的提交上）。

These files are committed. They hold paths, verdicts and the reviewer's own words — conclusions, at the same sensitivity as everything else in the repository. No client document is among them.

这些文件均已入库：内容为路径、裁定和审阅人写下的文字， 均属结论，敏感度与代码库其他内容相同，不含任何客户文档。

# structural checks over the real corpus; opens no port
python validate\serve.py --check

# every suite in the repository, one command
python test_all.py
# 对真实数据做结构性检查；不开端口
python validate\serve.py --check

# 一条命令执行代码库中的全部测试
python test_all.py
Back the answers up 记得将答案带出来

The only copy of a reviewer's work is on the workstation share until somebody runs python bundle.py results by hand. Nothing schedules that, and run.py --fresh deletes the folder it lives in. Pack the results at the end of any day people reviewed.

在有人手工执行 python bundle.py results 之前， 审阅成果仅存于工作站共享盘上的一份。 没有定时任务执行此操作，而 run.py --fresh 会删除该文件夹。当天只要有人审阅，当天工作结束时就应打包。

CThe review sheet — when there is no server离线审阅表单 —— 无服务端时

One HTML file on a shared folder. No sign-in, nothing running, and the same act of review underneath.

共享文件夹中的一个 HTML 文件：无需登录、无程序运行， 完成的是同一件事。

# what would be built; writes nothing
python validate\handout.py data --check

# build the sheets, beside the treaty folders
python validate\handout.py data --out "R:\...\review" --reviewer "A. Reviewer"

# fold the returned answers back in through the same ledger
python validate\handout.py data --collect "R:\...\review\returned"
# 预览将生成的内容；不写入任何内容
python validate\handout.py data --check

# 生成表单，放在合约文件夹旁边
python validate\handout.py data --out "R:\...\review" --reviewer "A. Reviewer"

# 将收回的答案通过同一套记录合并回去
python validate\handout.py data --collect "R:\...\review\returned"

Where to put it

放在哪里

The page goes beside the treaty folders, copied out of the staging tree, so its links to documents are relative and no drive letter can break them. Put it anywhere else and the filenames stop opening.

应放在合约文件夹旁边（从暂存目录一并拷出）， 链接才是相对路径、不受盘符影响。 放在别处，文件名将无法打开。

What to tell the reviewer

需要告知审阅人的事项

  • Mark only what is wrong. Everything else stands as the machine had it.
  • Press Confirm on each submission — the same rule as the app: a submission nobody confirmed counts for nothing.
  • Save the file back to the returned folder when finished.
  • 只标错的地方。其余全部保持机器的判断。
  • 每份提交都要按 Confirm（确认） —— 与应用中的规则相同：未经确认的提交一律无效。
  • 完成后将文件存回「已返回」文件夹。
Two differences from the app, on purpose 与应用有意保留的两处差异

The sheet carries no gate verdict — "do not trust this" is too strong a thing to tell a reviewer about a rule that is being recalibrated. And its row control is a single button whose label changes, rather than the app's three fixed positions.

表单不带机器的红黄绿判定 —— 规则正在重新校准，「不要相信」这类提示言之过重。 此外每行只有一个文字会变化的按钮，而非应用的三个固定按钮。

Never at the same time as the server 切勿与服务同时运行

Do not run --collect while the review server is running. Two processes appending to one answer file can interleave, and an append-only file cannot be repaired by rewriting it.

服务运行期间请勿执行 --collect： 两个进程同时追加会相互交错， 而只追加的文件无法通过重写修复。

?If something stops出问题时

What you seeWhat it is
No sign-in page, no My work You are on Setup A. There is no configuration file, so there is nobody to sign in as. This is normal on every machine but the server.
Signed in, but the screen is empty An account with no assignment. Add them to assignments.csv.
Filenames are plain text and do not open The server was started without --files-root. Restart it with the folder holding the documents.
"The address is already in use" An older copy is still running. That is deliberate — it refuses to start rather than let your browser quietly talk to the old one.
An approval says stale The submission was triaged again after it was confirmed. The approval covered a set of documents that has moved; it needs confirming again.
Somebody's password needs resetting Accounts screen, or --add-account with the same name on the coding PC.
The whole app will not start Run python validate\serve.py --check. It opens no port and tells you what on disk it cannot make sense of.
你看到的现象原因
没有登录页，也没有 My work 部署 A：没有配置文件，也就不存在「谁」的概念。 除服务器外皆如此，属正常。
能登录，但界面空白 有账号无分派。将该人员加入 assignments.csv。
文件名是纯文字，无法点开 启动时未加 --files-root。 请带上存放文档的文件夹重启。
提示地址已被占用 仍有旧实例在运行。这是有意设计 —— 宁可启动失败，也不让浏览器悄悄连接到旧实例。
某个核准显示 stale（已过期） 确认后该提交又被重新分类，当初核准的那组文件已变化， 需重新确认。
要给某人重置密码 使用账号界面，或在开发机上用同一个名字执行 --add-account。
应用完全无法启动 执行 python validate\serve.py --check。 它不开端口，会指出磁盘上哪一部分无法读取。

Photographed from the running app on an invented corpus, 2026-09-08. Rebuild with python validate/manual_illustrated/build.py whenever a screen changes.
